settings.question: What does Baba Saleh sell?
settings.answer: Baba Saleh (بابا صالح) sells sports equipment and sportswear in Egypt: gym and fitness equipment, swimming gear and swimwear, football, basketball, racket sports, martial arts, beach gear, trophies and medals, and kids' toys.

settings.question: Do you deliver to all of Egypt?
settings.answer: Yes. We deliver to every governorate in Egypt, usually within 2–5 days.

settings.question: Can I pay cash on delivery?
settings.answer: Yes. You can pay in cash when your order arrives, anywhere in Egypt.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: You can return eligible items within 7 days. See our refund policy for details.

settings.question: Which brands do you carry?
settings.answer: Wilson, Everlast, Venum, Cressi, Dunlop, Track, Kuna, Spurt, LivePro, LiveUp, Cougar, Kiko, Manta, Wish and our own Baba Saleh range.

settings.question: How can I contact Baba Saleh?
settings.answer: Message us on WhatsApp or email support@babasaleh.com — real people reply fast.

settings.question: Do you have stores I can visit?
settings.answer: Yes. Visit us at our branches in Al Ahram, Imbaba, Giza, Maadi and 6th of October. Find addresses and directions on our contact page.

settings.question: Are your products original?
settings.answer: Yes. We sell original products from the brands we carry, plus our own Baba Saleh and Track ranges.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: Open the link in your order confirmation email, or sign in to your account to see your order status.

settings.question: Can I cancel my order?
settings.answer: Yes, before it ships. Message us on WhatsApp with your order number and we will cancel it.
